boards.title: Your First Weekend at California State University-Monterey Bay, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible Friday-to-Sunday sequence that introduces campus landmarks, social spaces, recreation, and nearby coastal destinations without assuming event schedules or unverified hours.

cards.title: Start with the Otters
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Otter Student Union plaza
cards.notes: Find the bronze pair outside the student union, take a first-campus photo, and notice the donor names embedded in Ocean Path.
cards.short_summary: Begin the weekend at CSUMB’s documented gathering landmark and new-student photo stop.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB identifies the Otters for Life statue as a bronze campus landmark and documents first-campus photos as one of its traditions.
cards.source_title: Otter Statue | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: The statue stands near the Otter Student Union; the source does not state access hours.

cards.title: Learn the Union Layout
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus-life orientation
cards.notes: Walk through the union, locate its information desk and shared spaces, and note where to return when clubs or campus programs begin.
cards.short_summary: Use the student union as the weekend’s practical campus-life reference point.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB describes the Otter Student Union as a campus-life hub with spaces and services for events, clubs, relaxation, and exploring interests.
cards.source_title: Services and Resources | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Consult posted building information before visiting; the cited page does not provide current weekend hours.

cards.title: Pause for an Analog Game
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · inside the Otter Student Union
cards.notes: Look for the Rookery and choose from its documented pool, foosball, ping-pong, arcade, or console options if the room is open.
cards.short_summary: Add a low-pressure indoor social stop centered on named recreational equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: A CSUMB news report identifies the Rookery as the student union game room and lists pool tables, foosball, ping-pong, arcade games, and consoles.
cards.source_title: State-of-the-art esports lounge opens with fanfare and excitement
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to current Otter Student Union operating hours and any room reservations.

cards.title: Try the Esports Lounge
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · OSU third floor
cards.notes: Head to the third floor and check whether a station is available for casual play; follow the posted community standards while gaming.
cards.short_summary: Switch from tabletop recreation to CSUMB’s dedicated ten-computer gaming facility.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB states that the third-floor Otter Esports Lounge has ten gaming PCs supporting casual and competitive play.
cards.source_title: Otter Esports Lounge | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: The facility is intended for CSUMB students; verify current lounge hours and station availability in the union.

cards.title: Settle in Over Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Dining Commons
cards.notes: Check the current menu, then use a meal swipe or buy a single meal to enter the all-you-care-to-enjoy residential dining commons.
cards.short_summary: Make the campus dining commons the sequence’s clearly documented meal stop.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB says The Eatery is its residential dining commons, with entry available through one meal swipe or a single-meal purchase.
cards.source_title: Dining Services | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Menus and operating hours are maintained on the linked Otter Kitchens site and should be checked before departure.

cards.title: Plan a Two-Wheel Outing
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Student Center East Lounge
cards.notes: Stop at Room 157 to ask about rentals, repairs, group rides, or free trip-planning help before choosing a route beyond campus.
cards.short_summary: Use CSUMB’s named bike shop to turn a vague ride idea into a safer route plan.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB identifies the Otter Cycle Center as its campus bike shop and documents rentals, repairs, organized rides, clinics, and free trip-planning help.
cards.source_title: Otter Cycle Center Home | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: The center is in Student Center East Lounge, Room 157; confirm current Saturday hours before relying on an in-person visit.

cards.title: Follow the Cypress Baskets
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Inter-Garrison Road area
cards.notes: Use the campus map to find the Cypress Course, bring or obtain a disc, and keep play within marked course areas and away from traffic.
cards.short_summary: Try a named campus course tied directly to CSUMB’s recreation history.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB’s archived university magazine identifies the Cypress Course as a campus disc-golf course along Inter-Garrison Road across from University Police.
cards.source_title: 2016 Fall/Winter Archive | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Check the current campus map and posted course conditions; the historical source does not provide operating hours or equipment access.

cards.title: Hike a Signed Fort Ord Trail
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · public lands beside campus
cards.notes: Choose an authorized marked trail, carry water, and stay on-route to avoid sensitive habitat, poison oak, closures, and former-military hazards.
cards.short_summary: Extend the day onto protected public land with clear route and safety rules.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bureau of Land Management documents more than 86 miles of Fort Ord trails for hiking and biking and requires visitors to remain on authorized marked trails.
cards.source_title: Fort Ord National Monument | Bureau of Land Management
cards.access_notes: Use only signed open trails; heed closures and hazard signs. Motorized use is restricted, and conditions should be checked before departure.

cards.title: Take a Sunset Beach Walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Seaside access area
cards.notes: Arrive before sunset, use the designated access and parking area, and leave time to exit before the posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: Close Saturday with a regulated coastal walk rather than an unverified nighttime beach plan.
cards.evidence_claim: California State Parks lists Monterey State Beach’s hours as 8 a.m. to sunset and identifies sunset walks and beach recreation among its uses.
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m. to sunset. Dogs and beach fires are prohibited; observe current restrictions and posted water conditions.

cards.title: Save the Aquarium for Sunday
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Cannery Row via Monterey-Salinas Transit
cards.notes: Check admission options and transit schedules first; if using a student benefit, confirm that a new academic-year pass is actually available.
cards.short_summary: Finish with a major marine-learning destination while treating admission eligibility conservatively.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB documents the aquarium at 886 Cannery Row and provides an MST route from the Alumni and Visitor Center; its cited 2025–2026 student passes expired May 17, 2026.
cards.source_title: Monterey Bay Aquarium Student Passes | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Do not rely on the expired 2025–2026 pass. Verify current aquarium admission, any renewed student-pass program, and current MST schedules.

warnings: The university’s published 2025–2026 Monterey Bay Aquarium passes expired May 17, 2026; the aquarium card therefore does not claim free admission.
Current weekend hours were not published on several cited campus pages, so those cards explicitly require checking posted hours before visiting.
